verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js, plus an HTTP API for server-side ingestion, and explicitly implements the documented event types identify, track, page, screen, and group. Documentation also covers batch submission and streaming ingestion (Kafka/Pub/Sub) as alternatives, confirming a full tracking spec. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK reliability or completeness across platforms beyond first-party docs.
